before: Leave the session in Closing and permit export retry; mark Closed only after a complete export is confirmed.
after: Stay Closing and retry; close only after a complete export.

before: Use an explicit intermediate state when completion depends on a fallible operation. In this case, Leave the session in Closing and permit export retry; mark Closed only after a complete export is confirmed.
after: Use an explicit intermediate state when completion depends on a fallible operation. In this case, Stay Closing and retry; close only after a complete export.

before: Apply an acceptance only when its proposal ID matches the currently pending proposal; otherwise record it as stale and leave current state unchanged.
after: Apply only a response for the current pending proposal; mark delayed P1 stale.
